conclusions: Initialized final model succeeds on all 36 matched-distribution gap validation layouts and all 12 OOD layouts; cold final model succeeds on 9/36 and 0/12 respectively.

Initialized stochastic validation success is 77.5%, fixed-initial-observation control 29.44%; this supports a benefit from changing state input, but does not isolate which observation feature is responsible.
Both final models preserve flat 4/4 but only obstacle 3/4. Initialized best-gap checkpoint preserves obstacle 2/4; task-specific best selection is not a deployment readiness guarantee.
No mixed promotion: obstacle retention fails. Next round should restore obstacle performance with gap retention and successful-episode speed limits, before multi-seed acceptance.
These are single-training-seed development results. Initialization has 90,112 prior transitions; the two runs have equal new budgets, not equal total historical compute.
